authority.lock_procedure: After SV1 review, SV3 writes a lock and train authorization binding this protocol, the plan manifest and the source hashes (approved_by SV3, review evidence = the SV1 review), as for M1 v4

predecessor.relation: This protocol replaces the nopeek section of protocol v4 for the NoPeek stage; protocol v4 is not edited

initialization.checkpoint: Package A deployment checkpoint C5-seed20261101 epoch 4
initialization.rule: Every pilot and grid run starts from this same checkpoint with a new optimizer; no weights carried between runs
initialization.epoch0: Epoch 0 is the loaded checkpoint, evaluated before any update; its validation confusion must equal the locked A confusion, else the run stops as a technical fault

data.bound_files: train_X.npy, train_y.npy, train_metadata.csv, val_X.npy, val_y.npy, val_metadata.csv with the SHA-256 values of plan v4 binding.data_files
data.selection: DS1 validation only (utility, collapse, epoch, lambda and deployment seed)
data.DS2: Never opened in pilot or grid; never an input to lambda, epoch, seed, learning rate, noise or threshold

dcor_validation_subset.rule: As protocol v4 nopeek.fixed_dcor_validation_subset; same 512 ordered samples for every run and epoch, one full biased-sample R_n batch, eval mode

objective.R_n: Biased sample distance correlation, not squared (ml/src/distance_correlation.py); x is the normalized input flattened to [B,360], z_s the head output at split s flattened to [B, C*L] or [B, C]
objective.CE: Unweighted cross-entropy over 5 outputs on K-balanced batches, as configuration C5 of package A
objective.lambda0: At lambda 0 the dCor term carries no gradient; R_n is still logged
objective.trained_parameters: Head and tail jointly (all 109653 parameters); dropout active in training, off in evaluation

training.learning_rate: Constant; value fixed by the pilot from the candidates below; no scheduler
training.early_stopping: None; every run trains exactly 10 epochs so that epoch selection sees the same horizon for every lambda
training.seeding: Global model/dropout RNG seeded once per run with the run seed; data generator seed+epoch-1, as the package A trainer
training.determinism: CUDA on the RTX 5060 training machine; torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True); cuDNN deterministic, benchmark off; CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8; one device for pilot and grid
training.checkpoints: Save the epoch 0-10 state of every run; checkpoint files are the model evidence because other GPUs do not reproduce bit-exact
training.per_epoch_log: Validation 5x5 confusion, macro-F1 K, accuracy, per-class Se/+P, R_n on the 512 subset at s; train mean CE and mean batch R_n; learning rate

pilot.purpose: Fix the learning rate before the grid so that fine-tuning does not damage package A (v1.2 4.5 fix 1); not part of the grid and never an input to lambda selection
pilot.runs: For each candidate: lambda 0 once (independent of s) and lambda 5 at s2 and s8; seed 20261030; 10 epochs; 9 runs
pilot.safe_learning_rate: Lambda 0 run: utility passes at every epoch 1-10 and no epoch is collapsed
pilot.choice: Among safe candidates, minimize the mean over s2 and s8 of the lowest subset R_n among lambda-5 epochs 1-10 that pass utility (a run with no passing epoch counts as R_n 1); tie: smaller learning rate
pilot.no_safe_candidate: Stop; report all pilot curves to SV1, who decides before any grid run
pilot.after_pilot: Receipt with the chosen learning rate and all curves sent to SV1; the grid starts after the receipt

grid.lambda0_determinism_check: The 12 lambda-0 runs train identically across s; for each seed their epoch 1-10 checkpoints must be bit-identical across s, else investigate as a technical fault before selection
grid.no_adaptive_expansion: No added lambda, seed, learning rate or epoch after results

utility.metric: Validation macro-F1 over N, S, V, F (fixed4), argmax over 5 outputs, zero_division 0
utility.gate: macro_f1_K(checkpoint) >= 19/20 * macro_f1_K(A), computed exactly with Fraction from the 5x5 confusion

collapse: As protocol v4: at the selected checkpoint after reload, any class >= 99 % of predictions OR Se_V < 0.10; keep the numbers; a lambda with any collapsed seed is ineligible

epoch_selection.lambda0: Max validation macro-F1 over epochs 0-10, epoch 0 included; tie: earlier epoch
epoch_selection.positive_lambda: Among epochs 1-10 that pass utility, minimum subset R_n; tie: earlier epoch. If none passes: max macro-F1 among epochs 1-10, marked UTILITY_FAIL; epoch 0 never selected

lambda_selection: Per s, among lambdas with all 3 seeds complete, utility passed and not collapsed, minimize the mean subset R_n of the 3 selected checkpoints; tie: smaller lambda. Lambda 0 is always eligible (epoch 0 is A)
deployment_seed: Per s, the seed whose selected checkpoint has the median raw subset R_n among the 3; equal medians: smaller seed
statistics: All seed values, mean and sample SD (ddof 1); collapsed and UTILITY_FAIL values retained; a technical fault allows one same-seed retry; a missing seed means no 2-seed mean

reporting_before_privacy.lambda0_curve: Before any attack or Pi evaluation on NoPeek checkpoints, send SV1 the per-epoch validation macro-F1 of lambda 0 (epochs 0-10, three seeds) with the utility threshold and the per-lambda pass counts
reporting_before_privacy.sv1_decision: If lambda 0 often fails the threshold, SV1 decides before any Pi is computed; the threshold itself stays as declared

figures: Macro-F1 and R_n versus lambda per s, with the package A line and an always-N line; IEEE style: Times 8 pt, width 3.5 or 7.16 in, vector PDF and PNG 600 dpi, no title

rho1_output.definition: rho1 at split s = head and tail of the selected lambda's deployment-seed checkpoint; no noise
rho1_output.splits: s2 and the middle cut (s4 or s5, rule below); s8 is offline only
rho1_output.package_B: Package B carries the NoPeek checkpoints with matching head/tail/full/normalization/protection identity; never mixed with package A

downstream_middle_cut_rule.source: SV1 review 2026-11-05 item 6a, fixed before any number
downstream_middle_cut_rule.rule: Consider rho in {rho0, rho1}. If s4 has a rho reaching Pi_min, use s4. Else if s5 has one, use s5. Else use s4 and consider rho2
downstream_middle_cut_rule.inputs: Week 11 attack trial on DS1 (A1 + B-naive); not part of this grid's selection

extension_stage: Teacher's tail fine-tune and extension to other s (validation accuracy drop <= 2 percentage points AND macro-F1 >= 0.95 x A) is a separate stage under its own protocol version

change_control.locked_file: Never edit after lock; any change is a new version with reason, old/new hashes and SV1 review before dependent runs
change_control.DS2: Report only, after model/quantization lock; never a tuning input

execution_in_this_round.code: Runner, plan manifest and tests are written after SV1 reviews this protocol and are bound by SHA in the lock
